notes: The list is essentially complete. All of Schubert's original works for violin are present: D. 345, 438, 574, 580, 895 and 934, the three Sonatinas Op. 137 and the Ländler. The main established arrangements by Wilhelmj, Kreisler and Friedberg are present or queued, and I could not name a confirmed, publishable edition for any further arrangement (e.g. Franko's Valse sentimentale), so none were added.
